===
labeled single statements
===

procedure Main;
begin
  if a then
    FirstLabel: SecondLabel: b
  else
    c;

  while a do
    WhileLabel: d;

  for i := a to b do
    ForLabel: e;

  with a do
    WithLabel: f;

  case a of
    1: CaseLabel: g;
  end;

  OuterLabel: if b then
    ThenLabel: h
  else
    ElseLabel: i;

  goto EmptyLabel;
  EmptyLabel:
end;

---

(root
  (defProc
    (declProc (kProcedure) (identifier))
    (block
      (kBegin)
      (ifElse
        (kIf) (identifier) (kThen)
        (labeledStatement
          (label (identifier))
          (label (identifier))
          (statement (identifier)))
        (kElse)
        (statement (identifier)))
      (while
        (kWhile) (identifier) (kDo)
        (labeledStatement
          (label (identifier))
          (statement (identifier))))
      (for
        (kFor)
        (assignment (identifier) (kAssign) (identifier))
        (kTo) (identifier) (kDo)
        (labeledStatement
          (label (identifier))
          (statement (identifier))))
      (with
        (kWith) (identifier) (kDo)
        (labeledStatement
          (label (identifier))
          (statement (identifier))))
      (case
        (kCase) (identifier) (kOf)
        (caseCase
          (caseLabel (literalNumber))
          (labeledStatement
            (label (identifier))
            (statement (identifier))))
        (kEnd))
      (label (identifier))
      (ifElse
        (kIf) (identifier) (kThen)
        (labeledStatement
          (label (identifier))
          (statement (identifier)))
        (kElse)
        (labeledStatement
          (label (identifier))
          (statement (identifier))))
      (goto (kGoto) (identifier))
      (label (identifier))
      (kEnd))))

===
numeric labels in single-statement contexts
===

program Main;
label 1, 2;
begin
  if a then
    1: b;
  while a do
    2: c;
end.

---

(root
  (program
    (kProgram) (moduleName (identifier))
    (declLabels
      (kLabel)
      (declLabel (labelNumber))
      (declLabel (labelNumber)))
    (block
      (kBegin)
      (if
        (kIf) (identifier) (kThen)
        (labeledStatement
          (label (labelNumber))
          (statement (identifier))))
      (while
        (kWhile) (identifier) (kDo)
        (labeledStatement
          (label (labelNumber))
          (statement (identifier))))
      (kEnd))
    (kEndDot)))

===
labeled nested statements keep dangling else binding
===

procedure Main;
begin
  if a then
    OuterLabel: if b then
      ThenLabel: c
    else
      InnerElseLabel: d
  else
    OuterElseLabel: e;
end;

---

(root
  (defProc
    (declProc (kProcedure) (identifier))
    (block
      (kBegin)
      (ifElse
        (kIf) (identifier) (kThen)
        (labeledStatement
          (label (identifier))
          (ifElse
            (kIf) (identifier) (kThen)
            (labeledStatement
              (label (identifier))
              (statement (identifier)))
            (kElse)
            (labeledStatement
              (label (identifier))
              (statement (identifier)))))
        (kElse)
        (labeledStatement
          (label (identifier))
          (statement (identifier))))
      (kEnd))))

===
labeled foreach and exception-handler bodies
===

procedure Main;
begin
  for Item in Items do
    ForEachLabel: a;

  try
    b;
  except
    on E: Exception do
      HandlerLabel: c;
    else
      ElseLabel: d;
  end;
end;

---

(root
  (defProc
    (declProc (kProcedure) (identifier))
    (block
      (kBegin)
      (foreach
        (kFor) (identifier) (kIn) (identifier) (kDo)
        (labeledStatement
          (label (identifier))
          (statement (identifier))))
      (try
        (kTry)
        (statements
          (statement (identifier)))
        (kExcept)
        (exceptionHandler
          (kOn) (identifier) (typeref (identifier)) (kDo)
          (labeledStatement
            (label (identifier))
            (statement (identifier))))
        (exceptionElse
          (kElse)
          (labeledStatement
            (label (identifier))
            (statement (identifier))))
        (kEnd))
      (kEnd))))
